notes: Sibling project to ../esp8266-tilt-prototype/, same three user-supplied breakouts (TP4056, GY-291, MCP9808) but on a generic ESP32 Dev Kit V1 instead of an ESP8266 D1 Mini. Firmware needed almost no porting -- the production board's own fermentation_tilt_v1.ino already targets a bare ESP32 with the same GPIO numbers this design uses (4, 21, 22, 25, 34); only the battery-sense path changed (ungated, single-stage 100k/100k divider vs the production board's gated divider). Both known netlistsvg/elkjs rendering crash patterns discovered during the ESP8266 rig's development (NOCONNECT-vs-typed-pin-wired-to-NC; single driver fanning into two same-part inputs) were fixed proactively in mcu_core.py and sensor_bus.py, so the schematic SVG/PDF generated clean on the first attempt. Firmware compiles clean against esp32:esp32 core 3.3.12, board esp32doit-devkit-v1 (85% flash, 15% RAM -- comfortable headroom, unlike the ESP8266 rig's tight 93% IRAM). Hardware is entirely unverified pending a photo of the actual board -- see architecture/design_risks.md's note on ESP32 Dev Kit V1 pin-layout variance across vendors. No physical build/mounting guide yet (SPEC.md scopes that out for now, unlike the ESP8266 rig's Prototype Shield guide) -- add one if requested.
